ko.tours.loadBalancers.label: 로드밸런서 생성·삭제
ko.tours.loadBalancers.summary: 프로젝트 서브넷에 로드밸런서를 만들고 상세 화면에서 확인한 뒤 삭제합니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: 로드밸런서 생성 열기
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: '+ 로드밸런서 생성'을 눌러 생성 화면을 엽니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: 이름·네트워크·서브넷 입력
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: 이름을 입력하고 sample-private 같은 프로젝트 네트워크를 고른 뒤, 'VIP 서브넷'에서 그 서브넷을 선택하고 '생성'을 누르세요. 이름과 서브넷이 모두 있어야 생성됩니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: 새 로드밸런서 확인
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: 새 로드밸런서의 상세 화면이 열렸습니다. 상태와 VIP 주소를 확인하세요. 프로비저닝이 끝나 상태가 ACTIVE가 되면 삭제할 수 있습니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: 로드밸런서 삭제
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: 이 로드밸런서의 '삭제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 로드밸런서와 리스너·풀이 함께 삭제되고 목록으로 돌아갑니다.
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: 로드밸런서 목록에서 방금 만든 로드밸런서가 사라졌는지 확인하세요.
ko.tours.routers.label: 라우터 생성·삭제
ko.tours.routers.summary: 라우터를 만들고 목록에서 연 뒤 삭제합니다.
ko.tours.routers.step1.title: 라우터 생성 열기
ko.tours.routers.step1.description: '+ 라우터 생성'을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.routers.step2.title: 이름·게이트웨이 입력
ko.tours.routers.step2.description: 라우터 이름을 입력하세요. 외부 네트워크는 선택 사항입니다. '외부 게이트웨이 없음'을 그대로 두거나, 인터넷 연결이 필요하면 외부 네트워크를 고른 뒤 '생성'을 누르세요.
ko.tours.routers.step3.title: 새 라우터 열기
ko.tours.routers.step3.description: 새 라우터가 목록에 추가됐습니다. 이 라우터의 '상세'를 눌러 패널을 여세요.
ko.tours.routers.step4.title: 라우터 삭제
ko.tours.routers.step4.description: 라우터 패널의 '삭제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.routers.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.routers.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 라우터가 삭제되고 패널이 닫힙니다.
ko.tours.routers.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.routers.step6.description: 목록에서 방금 만든 라우터가 사라졌는지 확인하세요.

en.tours.loadBalancers.label: Create·delete load balancers
en.tours.loadBalancers.summary: Create a load balancer on a project subnet, check it on its detail page, then delete it.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: Open load balancer creation
en.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: Click + Create load balancer to open the create page.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: Name, network and subnet
en.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: Enter a name, pick a project network such as sample-private, then choose its subnet under VIP subnet and click Create. A name and a subnet are both required.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: Check the new load balancer
en.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: The detail page of the new load balancer is open. Check its status and VIP address. Delete becomes available once provisioning finishes and the status is ACTIVE.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: Delete the load balancer
en.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: Click Delete on this load balancer. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The load balancer is deleted together with its listeners and pools, and you return to the list.
en.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: On the load balancer list, check that the load balancer you created is gone.
en.tours.routers.label: Create·delete routers
en.tours.routers.summary: Create a router, open it from the list, then delete it.
en.tours.routers.step1.title: Open router creation
en.tours.routers.step1.description: Click + Create router to open the create dialog.
en.tours.routers.step2.title: Name and gateway
en.tours.routers.step2.description: Enter a router name. The external network is optional: keep No external gateway, or pick an external network for internet access. Then click Create.
en.tours.routers.step3.title: Open the new router
en.tours.routers.step3.description: The new router was added to the list. Click Details on this router to open its panel.
en.tours.routers.step4.title: Delete the router
en.tours.routers.step4.description: Click Delete in the router panel. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.routers.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.routers.step5.description: Click Confirm in the dialog. The router is deleted and the panel closes.
en.tours.routers.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.routers.step6.description: Check that the router you created is gone from the list.

ja.tours.loadBalancers.label: ロードバランサーの作成・削除
ja.tours.loadBalancers.summary: プロジェクトのサブネットにロードバランサーを作成し、詳細画面で確認してから削除します。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: ロードバランサー作成を開く
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: 「+ ロードバランサーを作成」を押して作成画面を開きます。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: 名前・ネットワーク・サブネットの入力
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: 名前を入力し、sample-private などのプロジェクトネットワークを選んでから、「VIPサブネット」でそのサブネットを選択し「作成」を押してください。名前とサブネットの両方が必要です。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: 新しいロードバランサーを確認
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: 新しいロードバランサーの詳細画面が開きました。ステータスとVIPアドレスを確認してください。プロビジョニングが終わりステータスがACTIVEになると削除できます。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: ロードバランサーを削除
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: このロードバランサーの「削除」ボタンを押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: 削除の確認
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、ロードバランサーがリスナー・プールとともに削除され、一覧に戻ります。
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: ロードバランサー一覧から、作成したロードバランサーが消えたことを確認してください。
ja.tours.routers.label: ルーターの作成・削除
ja.tours.routers.summary: ルーターを作成し、一覧から開いてから削除します。
ja.tours.routers.step1.title: ルーター作成を開く
ja.tours.routers.step1.description: 「+ ルーターを作成」を押して作成ダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.routers.step2.title: 名前とゲートウェイの入力
ja.tours.routers.step2.description: ルーター名を入力してください。外部ネットワークは任意です。「外部ゲートウェイなし」のままにするか、インターネット接続が必要なら外部ネットワークを選んでから「作成」を押してください。
ja.tours.routers.step3.title: 新しいルーターを開く
ja.tours.routers.step3.description: 新しいルーターが一覧に追加されました。このルーターの「詳細」を押してパネルを開いてください。
ja.tours.routers.step4.title: ルーターを削除
ja.tours.routers.step4.description: ルーターパネルの「削除」ボタンを押してください。確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.routers.step5.title: 削除の確認
ja.tours.routers.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、ルーターが削除されパネルが閉じます。
ja.tours.routers.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.routers.step6.description: 一覧から、作成したルーターが消えたことを確認してください。

zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.label: 创建·删除负载均衡器
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.summary: 在项目子网上创建负载均衡器，在详情页确认后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: 打开负载均衡器创建
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建负载均衡器”打开创建页面。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: 填写名称、网络和子网
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: 输入名称，选择 sample-private 等项目网络，然后在“VIP 子网”中选择其子网并点击“创建”。名称和子网都必须填写。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: 确认新的负载均衡器
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: 新负载均衡器的详情页已打开。请确认其状态和 VIP 地址。预配完成、状态变为 ACTIVE 后即可删除。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: 删除负载均衡器
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: 点击此负载均衡器的“删除”按钮，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，负载均衡器将连同其监听器和池一起删除，并返回列表。
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: 在负载均衡器列表中确认刚创建的负载均衡器已消失。
zh-CN.tours.routers.label: 创建·删除路由器
zh-CN.tours.routers.summary: 创建路由器，从列表中打开后将其删除。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step1.title: 打开路由器创建
zh-CN.tours.routers.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建路由器”打开创建对话框。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step2.title: 填写名称和网关
zh-CN.tours.routers.step2.description: 输入路由器名称。外部网络为可选项：保持“无外部网关”，或在需要访问互联网时选择外部网络，然后点击“创建”。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step3.title: 打开新路由器
zh-CN.tours.routers.step3.description: 新路由器已添加到列表中。点击此路由器的“详情”打开面板。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step4.title: 删除路由器
zh-CN.tours.routers.step4.description: 点击路由器面板中的“删除”按钮，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.routers.step5.description: 在确认对话框中点击“确认”，路由器即被删除，面板随之关闭。
zh-CN.tours.routers.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.routers.step6.description: 确认刚创建的路由器已从列表中消失。

bn.tours.loadBalancers.label: লোড ব্যালান্সার তৈরি ও মুছুন
bn.tours.loadBalancers.summary: প্রকল্পের সাবনেটে একটি লোড ব্যালান্সার তৈরি করুন, বিস্তারিত পাতায় যাচাই করুন, তারপর মুছে ফেলুন।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: লোড ব্যালান্সার তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: “+ লোড ব্যালান্সার তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করে তৈরির পাতা খুলুন।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: নাম, নেটওয়ার্ক ও সাবনেট
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: একটি নাম লিখুন, sample-private-এর মতো একটি প্রকল্প নেটওয়ার্ক বাছুন, তারপর “VIP সাবনেট”-এ তার সাবনেট বেছে “তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করুন। নাম ও সাবনেট দুটোই লাগবে।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: নতুন লোড ব্যালান্সার যাচাই
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: নতুন লোড ব্যালান্সারের বিস্তারিত পাতা খুলেছে। এর অবস্থা ও VIP ঠিকানা দেখুন। প্রভিশনিং শেষ হয়ে অবস্থা ACTIVE হলে মুছে ফেলা যাবে।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: লোড ব্যালান্সার মুছুন
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: এই লোড ব্যালান্সারের “মুছে ফেলুন” বোতামে ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: মুছে ফেলা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে লোড ব্যালান্সারটি তার লিসেনার ও পুলসহ মুছে যাবে এবং আপনি তালিকায় ফিরে যাবেন।
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: মুছে ফেলা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: লোড ব্যালান্সার তালিকা থেকে আপনার তৈরি লোড ব্যালান্সারটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।
bn.tours.routers.label: রাউটার তৈরি ও মুছুন
bn.tours.routers.summary: একটি রাউটার তৈরি করুন, তালিকা থেকে খুলুন, তারপর মুছে ফেলুন।
bn.tours.routers.step1.title: রাউটার তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.routers.step1.description: “+ রাউটার তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করে তৈরির ডায়ালগ খুলুন।
bn.tours.routers.step2.title: নাম ও গেটওয়ে
bn.tours.routers.step2.description: রাউটারের নাম লিখুন। বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্ক ঐচ্ছিক: “কোনো বাহ্যিক গেটওয়ে নেই” রেখে দিন, অথবা ইন্টারনেট সংযোগের জন্য একটি বাহ্যিক নেটওয়ার্ক বাছুন। তারপর “তৈরি করুন” ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.routers.step3.title: নতুন রাউটার খুলুন
bn.tours.routers.step3.description: নতুন রাউটারটি তালিকায় যোগ হয়েছে। এর প্যানেল খুলতে এই রাউটারের “বিস্তারিত” ক্লিক করুন।
bn.tours.routers.step4.title: রাউটার মুছুন
bn.tours.routers.step4.description: রাউটার প্যানেলে “মুছুন” বোতামে ক্লিক করুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.routers.step5.title: মুছে ফেলা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.routers.step5.description: ডায়ালগে “নিশ্চিত করুন” ক্লিক করলে রাউটারটি মুছে যাবে এবং প্যানেল বন্ধ হবে।
bn.tours.routers.step6.title: মুছে ফেলা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.routers.step6.description: তালিকা থেকে আপনার তৈরি রাউটারটি সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।

ms.tours.loadBalancers.label: Cipta·padam pengimbang beban
ms.tours.loadBalancers.summary: Cipta pengimbang beban pada subnet projek, semak di halaman butirannya, kemudian padamkannya.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: Buka penciptaan pengimbang beban
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: Klik + Cipta pengimbang beban untuk membuka halaman cipta.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: Nama, rangkaian dan subnet
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: Masukkan nama, pilih rangkaian projek seperti sample-private, kemudian pilih subnetnya di bawah Subnet VIP dan klik Cipta. Nama dan subnet kedua-duanya diperlukan.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: Semak pengimbang beban baharu
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: Halaman butiran pengimbang beban baharu telah dibuka. Semak status dan alamat VIPnya. Padam boleh digunakan sebaik sahaja penyediaan selesai dan status ialah ACTIVE.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: Padam pengimbang beban
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: Klik Padam pada pengimbang beban ini. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Pengimbang beban dipadam bersama pendengar dan kolamnya, dan anda kembali ke senarai.
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: Dalam senarai pengimbang beban, semak bahawa pengimbang beban yang anda cipta sudah tiada.
ms.tours.routers.label: Cipta·padam penghala
ms.tours.routers.summary: Cipta penghala, bukanya dari senarai, kemudian padamkannya.
ms.tours.routers.step1.title: Buka penciptaan penghala
ms.tours.routers.step1.description: Klik + Cipta penghala untuk membuka dialog cipta.
ms.tours.routers.step2.title: Nama dan get laluan
ms.tours.routers.step2.description: Masukkan nama penghala. Rangkaian luaran adalah pilihan: kekalkan Tiada get laluan luaran, atau pilih rangkaian luaran untuk akses internet. Kemudian klik Cipta.
ms.tours.routers.step3.title: Buka penghala baharu
ms.tours.routers.step3.description: Penghala baharu telah ditambah ke senarai. Klik Butiran pada penghala ini untuk membuka panelnya.
ms.tours.routers.step4.title: Padam penghala
ms.tours.routers.step4.description: Klik Padam dalam panel penghala. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.routers.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.routers.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog. Penghala dipadam dan panel ditutup.
ms.tours.routers.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.routers.step6.description: Semak bahawa penghala yang anda cipta tidak lagi ada dalam senarai.

nb.tours.loadBalancers.label: Opprett og slett lastbalanserere
nb.tours.loadBalancers.summary: Opprett en lastbalanserer på et prosjektundernett, kontroller den på detaljsiden og slett den deretter.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av lastbalanserer
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett lastbalanserer for å åpne opprettingssiden.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: Navn, nettverk og undernett
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: Skriv inn et navn, velg et prosjektnettverk som sample-private, velg deretter undernettet under VIP-undernett og klikk Opprett. Både navn og undernett er påkrevd.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: Kontroller den nye lastbalansereren
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: Detaljsiden for den nye lastbalansereren er åpen. Kontroller status og VIP-adresse. Sletting blir tilgjengelig når klargjøringen er ferdig og statusen er ACTIVE.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: Slett lastbalansereren
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: Klikk Slett på denne lastbalansereren. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Lastbalansereren slettes sammen med lyttere og pooler, og du kommer tilbake til listen.
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: Kontroller i listen over lastbalanserere at den du opprettet er borte.
nb.tours.routers.label: Opprett og slett rutere
nb.tours.routers.summary: Opprett en ruter, åpne den fra listen og slett den deretter.
nb.tours.routers.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av ruter
nb.tours.routers.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett ruter for å åpne opprettingsdialogen.
nb.tours.routers.step2.title: Navn og nettverksport
nb.tours.routers.step2.description: Skriv inn et rutenavn. Eksternt nettverk er valgfritt: behold Ingen ekstern nettverksport, eller velg et eksternt nettverk for internettilgang. Klikk deretter Opprett.
nb.tours.routers.step3.title: Åpne den nye ruteren
nb.tours.routers.step3.description: Den nye ruteren er lagt til i listen. Klikk Detaljer på denne ruteren for å åpne panelet.
nb.tours.routers.step4.title: Slett ruteren
nb.tours.routers.step4.description: Klikk Slett i ruterpanelet. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.routers.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.routers.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i dialogen. Ruteren slettes og panelet lukkes.
nb.tours.routers.step6.title: Sletting fullført
nb.tours.routers.step6.description: Kontroller at ruteren du opprettet er borte fra listen.

sw.tours.loadBalancers.label: Unda na futa visawazisha mzigo
sw.tours.loadBalancers.summary: Unda kisawazisha mzigo kwenye subnet ya mradi, kikague kwenye ukurasa wa maelezo, kisha kifute.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa kisawazisha mzigo
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: Bofya + Unda kisawazisha mzigo ili kufungua ukurasa wa kuunda.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: Jina, mtandao na subnet
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: Andika jina, chagua mtandao wa mradi kama sample-private, kisha chagua subnet yake chini ya Subnet ya VIP na ubofye Unda. Jina na subnet vyote vinahitajika.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: Kagua kisawazisha mzigo kipya
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: Ukurasa wa maelezo wa kisawazisha mzigo kipya umefunguka. Kagua hali yake na anwani ya VIP. Kufuta kunawezekana utoaji ukikamilika na hali ikiwa ACTIVE.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: Futa kisawazisha mzigo
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: Bofya Futa kwenye kisawazisha mzigo hiki. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: Thibitisha kufuta
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Kisawazisha mzigo kitafutwa pamoja na wasikilizaji na madimbwi yake, na utarudi kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: Kufuta kumekamilika
sw.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: Kwenye orodha ya visawazisha mzigo, thibitisha kuwa kile ulichounda hakionekani tena.
sw.tours.routers.label: Unda na futa vipanga njia
sw.tours.routers.summary: Unda kipanga njia, kifungue kutoka kwenye orodha, kisha kifute.
sw.tours.routers.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa kipanga njia
sw.tours.routers.step1.description: Bofya + Unda kipanga njia ili kufungua kisanduku cha kuunda.
sw.tours.routers.step2.title: Jina na lango
sw.tours.routers.step2.description: Andika jina la kipanga njia. Mtandao wa nje si lazima: acha Hakuna lango la nje, au chagua mtandao wa nje kwa ufikiaji wa intaneti. Kisha bofya Unda.
sw.tours.routers.step3.title: Fungua kipanga njia kipya
sw.tours.routers.step3.description: Kipanga njia kipya kimeongezwa kwenye orodha. Bofya Maelezo kwenye kipanga njia hiki ili kufungua paneli yake.
sw.tours.routers.step4.title: Futa kipanga njia
sw.tours.routers.step4.description: Bofya Futa kwenye paneli ya kipanga njia. Kisanduku cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.routers.step5.title: Thibitisha kufuta
sw.tours.routers.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kisanduku. Kipanga njia kitafutwa na paneli itafungwa.
sw.tours.routers.step6.title: Kufuta kumekamilika
sw.tours.routers.step6.description: Thibitisha kuwa kipanga njia ulichounda hakionekani tena kwenye orodha.

vi.tours.loadBalancers.label: Tạo·xóa bộ cân bằng tải
vi.tours.loadBalancers.summary: Tạo bộ cân bằng tải trên mạng con của dự án, kiểm tra ở trang chi tiết rồi xóa nó.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step1.title: Mở trang tạo bộ cân bằng tải
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step1.description: Nhấp + Tạo bộ cân bằng tải để mở trang tạo.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step2.title: Tên, mạng và mạng con
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step2.description: Nhập tên, chọn một mạng của dự án như sample-private, sau đó chọn mạng con của nó ở mục Mạng con VIP và nhấp Tạo. Cần có cả tên và mạng con.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step3.title: Kiểm tra bộ cân bằng tải mới
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step3.description: Trang chi tiết của bộ cân bằng tải mới đã mở. Kiểm tra trạng thái và địa chỉ VIP. Có thể xóa khi quá trình cấp phát hoàn tất và trạng thái là ACTIVE.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step4.title: Xóa bộ cân bằng tải
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step4.description: Nhấp Xóa trên bộ cân bằng tải này. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Bộ cân bằng tải sẽ bị xóa cùng các listener và pool của nó, và bạn quay lại danh sách.
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.loadBalancers.step6.description: Trong danh sách bộ cân bằng tải, kiểm tra rằng bộ bạn vừa tạo đã biến mất.
vi.tours.routers.label: Tạo·xóa bộ định tuyến
vi.tours.routers.summary: Tạo bộ định tuyến, mở nó từ danh sách rồi xóa nó.
vi.tours.routers.step1.title: Mở hộp thoại tạo bộ định tuyến
vi.tours.routers.step1.description: Nhấp + Tạo bộ định tuyến để mở hộp thoại tạo.
vi.tours.routers.step2.title: Tên và cổng mạng
vi.tours.routers.step2.description: Nhập tên bộ định tuyến. Mạng bên ngoài là tùy chọn: giữ Không có cổng mạng bên ngoài, hoặc chọn một mạng bên ngoài để truy cập internet. Sau đó nhấp Tạo.
vi.tours.routers.step3.title: Mở bộ định tuyến mới
vi.tours.routers.step3.description: Bộ định tuyến mới đã được thêm vào danh sách. Nhấp Chi tiết trên bộ định tuyến này để mở bảng điều khiển.
vi.tours.routers.step4.title: Xóa bộ định tuyến
vi.tours.routers.step4.description: Nhấp Xóa trong bảng bộ định tuyến. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.routers.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.routers.step5.description: Nhấp Xác nhận trong hộp thoại. Bộ định tuyến sẽ bị xóa và bảng sẽ đóng lại.
vi.tours.routers.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.routers.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng bộ định tuyến bạn vừa tạo đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.
